about: Shared test corpus of the extraction contract. Both languages parse every case and must reach its expected verdict: 'valid', 'schema' (refused by the structure), or the sorted list of invariant ids it breaks. An invalid case is a valid case ('base') with a patch: 'set' puts a value at a JSON Pointer ('-' appends to a list), 'remove' deletes it. Pairs check outputAnswersRequest / output_answers_request: 'expect' lists the pointers of the problems. Test data only: every value is synthetic and marked TEST.
